name: wrf-skill
description: Run WRF and WPS workflows from Codex using the repository's local and HPC orchestration scripts.

interface.shortDescription: Drive local and HPC WRF workflows from Codex
interface.longDescription: A native Codex plugin wrapper for this repository's WRF workflow layer. It helps Codex initialize projects, render configs, run WPS and WRF tasks, and inspect state through the existing scripts under scripts/.
defaultPrompt: Set up a WRF project in this workspace and render the config for my case.
Run only the WPS flow for this project and show me the logs.
Inspect the current WRF project state and tell me what blocks the next step.
